cohort: 465 Czech-speaking women in the Czech Republic
finding: The Czech version of the Birth Satisfaction Scale-Revised (CZ-BSS-R) was found to be a valid and reliable measure of birth experience, and instrument and emergency cesarean section were associated with lower birth satisfaction compared to vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Instrument and emergency Caesarean section were associated with a lower level of birth satisfaction compared to vaginal delivery.
